name: Neuronic whip
description: Neuronic whips were a type of whip with a metallic cable that, by the time of the Galactic Civil War, had a reputation for being the preferred weapon of enslavers. Borstel Galactic Defense produced a type of neuronic whip called the neuronic lash that they tried to distance from this reputation by changing its appearance and overall function, replacing the metallic cable with a flexible energy strand that was incapable of causing physical injury.
